name: Photon Torrent
effect: Every spawned enemy gains ability A03W (slow aura, Slo1=0.5) => +50% movement speed. [war3map.j:19672-19674; war3map.w3a A03W]

name: Spiritron Pollution
effect: Every added Servant gains ability A08V (Slo1=-0.5) => 50% slow; tagged '『Servant Contaminated』'. [war3map.j:1292-1294, 24738-24748; war3map.w3a A08V]

name: A little makes a lot
desc: Only E-grade units appear in the Draw
effect: Wisp draws force rank=1: only E-grade Servants appear; draw building tooltip becomes 'Random [E] Servant Draw / Penalty: E-grade Only'. [war3map.j:40050-40052, 19921-19935]

name: King's Army
desc: Very powerful mob (2000%) appears at the beginning of each round
effect: First enemy of every wave gains marker A0EW, HP x20 (2000%), MP x20, bounty x10. [war3map.j:20548-20553]

name: Surprise Attack
desc: Resources/unit gambling is prohibited or restricted
effect: Gambling buildings are downgraded: Nero H00F->H002 (loses high-rate servant gambling and Emperor's Privilege); other factions H002->H00E 'Corrupted Building' (only E/D/C servant gambling + 10G/100G gold gambling remain); BB H00Y->H00Z. [war3map.j:34875,35076,35374,35556,35678; war3map.w3u useu of H00F/H002/H00E/H00Y/H00Z]

name: RNG Interference
desc: 30% chance that the merging will be reversed
effect: 30% chance (GetRandomReal(0,100) <= 30) to abort a merge and replace its result with a random Servant of the same grade; tagged '『RNG Interference』'. [war3map.j:24619-24652]

name: Cash on Delivery
effect: Selling Servants is blocked: error sound + 'Penalty - Servants cannot be sold!'. [war3map.j:41276-41281]

name: Backup Protocol
desc: All enemy units gain HP regen
effect: All enemies gain A04J and regenerate 0.5% max HP and 1% max MP per second. [war3map.j:20567-20569; war3map.w3a A04J]

name: RAID 1
effect: Enemies spawn 2x (80 per wave instead of 40); each enemy has HP/MP halved and bounty halved; life-danger warning threshold doubled. [war3map.j:20471-20477, 20555-20560, 19807-19808]

name: Aftereffect
desc: When player unit kills an enemy, it's stunned for a while
effect: A Servant that kills an enemy is stunned for 1.0 s (Storm Bolt missile FX). [war3map.j:24708-24719]

name: We're one short
desc: Get one less chance(wisp) to draw units
effect: Round wisp bounty reduced from 3 to 2 ('We're one short' activated!). [war3map.j:20267-20278]

name: Imaginary Stasis
desc: Traps that stop the player units are periodically summoned
effect: Every 20 s (first after 10 s) summons 2 stasis traps per player at random positions (+/-960 around start location), FXRD_FXStasisField(x,y,3,10), stopping player units. [war3map.j:24762-24795]

name: Cyber Daemon Storm
desc: There is a storm that causes player units to bounce
effect: Summons 2 cyber typhoons (size 192) per player field that bounce/knock back player units; created 3 s after game init. [war3map.j:24817-24856]

name: Reverse Blast
desc: Enemy giant units cause a big explosion on death
effect: When a giant (boss) enemy dies it explodes: all player Servants stunned 10 s and knocked back (1000 range, 250 distance, 0.625 speed). [war3map.j:24663-24690]
